name: aimlapi
description: Skills for AI/ML API, one API for 10,000+ AI models and tools: choosing models, chat on any protocol, images, video and audio jobs, speech, decision models, webhooks, batches, errors, costs and sandbox testing

interface.longDescription: Skills that teach the agent to write code against AI/ML API, one OpenAI-compatible API for 10,000+ AI models and tools. The agent reads model ids, parameters and prices from the live catalogue, calls chat models on Chat Completions, Responses or Messages, runs image, video and speech jobs, uses decision models, webhooks and batches, retries only what is safe, reports what each call cost, and tests code for free in sandbox mode.
defaultPrompt: Which AI/ML API model should I use to animate a product photo, and what will it cost?
Move this OpenAI SDK code to AI/ML API and log the cost of each call
Write tests for my AI/ML API integration that run in sandbox mode
